albedo_source: NASA LROC WAC South Pole Summer Mosaic, 100 m, illumination divided out (reflectance only)
normal_source: NASA LOLA LDEM 60S, 240 m, tangent-space normals
height_source: NASA LOLA LDEM 60S, 240 m, 16-bit packed into R/G
psr_source: NASA PGDA 90 (Barker et al. 2023) LOLA 20 m permanently shadowed regions >= 1 km^2, LPSR_80S_20MPP_ADJ_1km2; 8-bit coverage fraction on the albedo grid
